topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Standing where the tree once stood, I trace the outline of its shadow in the soil with my toe. It's as if the earth remembers the weight of its roots, the gentle whisper of its leaves in the breeze. I planted that sapling with my own hands, watched it grow taller than the house, its branches reaching out like it was inviting the world to share in its shade. Now, the world has moved on, but I can still feel the bark under my fingers, rough and strong. The spot where it stood is empty, yet I can't help but smile, remembering the summer afternoons it sheltered, the autumn leaves it dropped with grace. Life is a cycle, and this is just the next chapter.
